_comment: CDC scenario FROM EMPTY: MySQL CDC over the binlog (ROW format, FULL row images, gtid_mode=ON), each publisher a replica with a server_id of its own; a change to a keyless table names its row by every column. The binlog has no row for what an ON DELETE CASCADE takes and no event for an UPDATE that changes nothing: --cascades unlogged --noops unlogged. An initial load pins its GTID position under a brief global read lock, so no change is both loaded and replayed. The model is installed and holds NO data when the stream starts, so everything it carries arrives as changes, from zero. STAGES: (1) domains -- create the mysqlcdc domain and install employeescdc, no create-data; (2) actions, tagged live -- `sentinel-data --key before-stream`, the one row the stream's initial load finds; (3) collections and (4) functions -- register mysqlcdc_initial_load (start_from=full), which STARTS it: its load is the empty tables and that sentinel; (5) sentinel -- hold until before-stream arrives, so the load is done before any data exists; (6) actions, tagged live -- the seed (`create-data --size 1`, one transaction), one `modify-data --ops Mix --sets 10` pass, `sentinel-data --key after-changes`; (7) sentinel -- hold until after-changes arrives; (8) actions, tagged check -- scripts/verify_cdc_ops.py --start initial-load: the load holds the sentinel alone, and the seed and every change after it arrive one by one, in their transactions, nothing of audit; (9) monitor. Generated by gen_suites.py. Run: `tdd xp one-shot --suite cdc/mysqlcdc_from_empty --keep`.
